result.title: PosteriorBench: Evaluating Behavior Posterior Sampling in Language Models
result.summary: Rare language model behaviors can be difficult to study because obtaining them through ordinary sampling can require a very large number of samples. This motivates the behavior posterior sampling problem: given a language model and a behavior of interest, is there an algorithm that efficiently samples from the model's distribution over transcripts that exhibit this behavior? We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for comparing algorithms by their compute cost and by how close their samples are to the true posterior in forward and reverse KL divergence. PosteriorBench contains 21 tasks on Qwen3.5-0.8B with behavior probabilities from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-1}$, each with exact posterior samples from a corpus of one billion labeled responses. We find that no method we evaluate is both efficient and faithful: simple methods like prompting are cheap but plateau at a high KL divergence from the posterior, fine-tuning on posterior samples is often cost-prohibitive, and several training methods from prior work do not perform better. Building a posterior sampler that can cheaply approximate the true posterior remains an open problem, and we hope PosteriorBench can measure progress towards this objective. Code and data are available at https://github.com/TransluceAI/PosteriorBench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PosteriorBench，在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上用 21 个行为概率从 1e-5 到 1e-1 的任务，配有十亿级标注响应中的精确后验样本，按计算成本与正反向 KL 距离比较 prompt、后验样本微调等算法的后验采样效果，发现没有方法同时做到高效与忠实。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身针对文本稀有行为而非视觉推理，但其对「稀有事件后验采样」算法与成本-保真度权衡的度量方式，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的采样筛选和轨迹获取提供方法线索，值得核查这些采样器能否用于 latent 推理状态。
